methodology: Warm synchronized API wall timings; separate one-call CUDA-event profile. Generation, validation and stream transfers excluded. CPU codec forbidden inside timed/profiled calls. Frozen streams permit identical decode comparisons.

aggregation.method: Concatenate every raw wall sample in run order; recompute summaries from the combined samples.
aggregation.run_order_basis: Run identities supplied to the CLI; raw profiles do not record execution timestamps.

kernel_diagnostics.scope: One separately instrumented call per case/operation from the first included run; not merged or summed.
